name: Trail Quest
description: A tiny trail-running adventure for your wrist. Cross five stages of The Ridge, choose your route at each fork, and meet the Trail Spirits: a stitch, the bonk, cramp, self-doubt. Beat them in short duels by timing your strike, fuel up when you run low, and take on a boss at the end of every stage. Beaten spirits can join your pack and lend you their moves. Your game is saved on the watch after every step. Nothing is sent to the phone, the UNA app or Strava.
